system.description:
Old forest, deep shade, and long stretches without a view of the sky. Trails fade within a day. Sound travels strangely between the trees. People learn to read tracks and wait in silence.

Talent: one Finesse die to d8.

  • Marked Prey. You learn the Marked Prey Technique: Ranged, Stress, +1, Pierce 1.
  • Camouflaged Skin. +2 on Stealth rolls.
